sources.title: Riehl, Category Theory in Context
sources.read_scope: Free category of a graph; nullary paths at each vertex; unique extension of quiver maps.
sources.mechanism: Anchored nil is interpreted as the identity at its own object.
sources.adaptation: Y1 adds raw bracketed trees and failed joins, retaining identity guards at every empty leaf.
sources.not_imported: Free-category universal property alone does not establish arbitrary malformed-tree or presented-carrier recovery.

sources.title: Mathlib PathCategory.Basic
sources.read_scope: Mature implementation of typed paths and their category interpretation.
sources.mechanism: Source-indexed empty paths and functorial interpretation.
sources.adaptation: Actual immutable V11 Category/Path is used in our kernel; Mathlib is a design/reference parent, not an imported dependency.
sources.not_imported: No claim that a Mathlib declaration was replayed by this Std-only proof build.

sources.title: Riccardi, Object-Free Definition of Categories
sources.locator: Category/partial-monoid reconstruction; Theorems51–53 roundtrips; Theorem28 identity issue
sources.read_scope: Classical arrows-only encoding, reconstruction and restrictions on multiplicative maps.
sources.mechanism: Objects can be recovered as units; explicit maps give category/partial-operation roundtrips.
sources.adaptation: Actual V19 unit, strong Option-associativity and coherence interface plus object/arrow maps are reused.
sources.not_imported: A multiplicative map alone is not presumed to preserve identities or arbitrary fixed object names.

sources.title: Cranch, Doherty and Struth, Relational Semigroups and Object-Free Categories
sources.locator: Sections2–4, coherent partial semigroups and local-unit reconstruction
sources.read_scope: Strong partial associativity, coherence and local identities; V19 records the exact unit-premise mapping.
sources.mechanism: Coherence bridges composability to matched local units.
sources.adaptation: V19 true units require self-composition and BOTH conditional neutral directions. A weaker literal left-OR-right neutral reading is not silently identified with this interface.
sources.not_imported: No theorem is claimed under only weak jointly-defined associativity or one-sided designated-unit assumptions.

sources.title: V9 attained-image recoverability
sources.mechanism: A decoder exists on attained codes exactly when the observation is constant on each code fiber.
sources.adaptation: Y2 and Y4 apply it to actual tree observers and extracted operation/map signatures.
sources.not_imported: No off-image default, literal-table incompressibility, shortest-description or independent-cell lower bound.

sources.title: V19 actual reconstruction and response maps
sources.locator: PartialUnits, BundledCategory, Reconstructed, ArrowRoundtrip, CategoryRoundtrip, Responses and controls
sources.mechanism: Actual lawful arrows-only construction and explicit response-preserving roundtrip maps.
sources.adaptation: Y1 retains nested empty anchors; Y2 adds carrier checks on common ambient labels; Y4 treats named object maps explicitly.
sources.not_imported: V19 did not already close original R1-001/007; its bare singleton assumes membership.

sources.title: V16 actual C4/V4 models
sources.locator: Actual four-label group operations, units and laws
sources.adaptation: Y3 observes the actual pair1,1, rather than semantic model-name selectors.
sources.not_imported: This witness does not distinguish admission and does not erase the qualified status of original R2-003.
